p: Flee as a bird to your: This is the wicked counsel of his enemies to him and his companions to drive him from the hope of God's promise.
foundations be destroyed: All hope of help is taken away.
righteous do: Yet am I innocent and my cause good.
behold: Though all things in earth are out of order, yet God will execute judgment from heaven.
fire and brimstone: As in the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah.
portion of their cup: Which they will drink even to the dregs, Eze 23:34.
